name: TN Waste Watch goal system
north_star: Help underserved Tennessee communities obtain trustworthy waste-management evidence, usable disposal access, and independently verified corrective improvements.

policy.completion: All acceptance criteria have attributable evidence and independent verification. No percentage based on tasks or documents.
policy.work_in_progress: One pilot delivery slice at a time; at most one independent review alongside it. Ownership is not executor liveness.
policy.review: On a meaningful evidence or decision change, reconcile the current gate; no recurring job has been activated.
policy.stagnation: After two attempts without gate advancement, change approach; after three, record a separate blocker with owner and clearing condition.
policy.priority: Need and unresolved concerns first; feasibility breaks ties; evidence abundance is not need. Missing data does not imply safety.
policy.next_slice_note: These IDs define one integrated pilot-preparation slice, not six concurrent jobs; select county via G2, then localize resource cards.

baseline.note: Research setup exists. Outcomes have not been established; none claimed.

goals.title: Trustworthy evidence
goals.owner: Research owner: this Hermes session; independent reviewer unassigned
goals.next_action: Create claim-level ledger for the first candidate and recover its original/current records.
acceptance: Every publishable factual claim has an actual HTTP receipt, source hash, exact quotation/page and event/source/retrieval dates.
Identity, historical/current/corrected/alleged/disputed status, counterevidence and unknowns are explicit.
Independent review checks the actual sources; failed retrievals retain actual status or network error.

goals.title: Rural-first prioritization
goals.next_action: Compare affected communities for the four candidates and include a discovery slot for a poorly documented community.
acceptance: Record community boundaries, rural/underserved evidence, disposal distance/cost/hours, well-dependence evidence and local records capacity; missing values remain unknown.
Choose the pilot with a written rationale based on need, unresolved concerns and feasibility—not media attention or number of documents.
Maintain separate urgency/discovery and substantiated/publication queues; document why candidates were deferred.

goals.title: First accountability-and-access pilot
goals.owner: Research owner: this Hermes session; technical reviewer unassigned
goals.next_action: Select one candidate; pair its dossier with a verified county disposal/service-accountability card and water-testing/referral card.
acceptance: One dossier passes claim, identity, current-status/unknown, privacy and appropriate technical/legal review gates.
Paired brief verifies service hours, fees, eligibility, accepted materials, destination and last-check dates using actual sources.
Maps and imagery use verified boundaries/capture dates/resolution; no imagery-based contamination or health inference. If imagery is unavailable, disclose it and publish no fabricated timeline.
Action panel identifies the responsible authority and source-backed next action; unresolved records gaps remain visible.
G9–G11 county cards pass their source, practical access, privacy and legal-currentness gates; statewide referral links alone do not satisfy the pilot.

goals.title: Safe resident assistance
goals.owner: Accountable operator unassigned; Michael must designate operator
goals.next_action: Define recipient, staffing, consent, retention/deletion and urgent-concern referral before testing intake.
acceptance: Named operator accepts responsibility and response capacity is accurately described.
Approved test demonstrates real downstream receipt; alerts and contributions are tested separately.
Privacy/consent, access restrictions, deletion, offline alternative and urgent-concern routing are documented and tested.
No public household/well identifiers or medical details; no promise of moderation or subscription without a working path.
goals.blocker: Named operator and approved intake-test scope required.

goals.title: Reliable statewide website
goals.owner: Implementation owner unassigned; research session prepares acceptance
goals.next_action: Prepare a visual/content contract; obtain publishing approval before changing the live site.
acceptance: Preserve Matlock dossier and reconcile imagery-date wording against provenance.
Provide statewide index with limited-coverage label, evidence status, verified update date, printable/low-bandwidth text and correction log.
All existing dossier harnesses plus new link, mobile, accessibility and claim checks pass from a pristine candidate export.
Git/review gates pass and approved release is independently read back live; a local page is not a deployed release.
Community help surfaces G9–G12 resources with source dates, uncertainty, offline options and existing-duty versus proposed-policy labels; no unverified county service promise.
goals.blocker: Pilot acceptance, implementation ownership and explicit publishing approval required.

goals.title: Feasible waste-practice improvements
goals.owner: Research owner: this Hermes session; local implementation partner unassigned
goals.next_action: Evaluate one access improvement against costs, legal destination, affordability and burden-shift risks.
acceptance: Compare feasible alternatives including no-change baseline, operating cost, transport, acceptance rules and downstream destination.
Verify funding availability/eligibility against the administering system; conflicts remain unconfirmed.
Any implemented pilot has separately approved owner/funding, baseline and before/after service or waste measurement.
No unsafe self-sampling, burning, trespass or handling unknown waste is recommended.

goals.title: Verified environmental and community outcomes
goals.owner: Measurement owner: this Hermes session; action owners recorded individually
goals.next_action: Create outcome entries as actions arise; define baseline and follow-up before claiming improvement.
acceptance: Corrective action is credited only with completion evidence and later effectiveness verification; sampling alone is not improvement.
Access change reports actual hours/fees/geography before and after; waste diversion reports baseline, units, period and destination without double counting.
Record the site contribution separately from causation and include adverse effects/burden shifts.
Zero or unknown outcomes are reported honestly; page views and dossier counts are delivery measures, not environmental outcomes.

goals.title: Transferable Tennessee playbook
goals.next_action: Extract a reusable method only after the pilot has usable evidence and follow-up.
acceptance: Reusable claim/dossier/access templates include provenance, privacy and current-status gates.
A second independently selected community can use the method without copying unsupported first-site conclusions.
Document what worked, what did not and limits of transfer; broader publication requires approval.

goals.title: Reachable private-well testing and follow-up
goals.owner: TN Waste Watch research session; local partner/reviewer unassigned
goals.next_action: For the selected community verify two feasible laboratory/referral routes, exact analytes, household acceptance, full cost, sample delivery and qualified interpretation.
acceptance: County water card verifies two feasible testing/referral routes, with certified analytes and expiration checks, household acceptance, practical sample delivery/holding times, full household price and necessary assistance. Unknown cost or access may remain in research but cannot pass completion. A single-route exception needs explicit operator approval and a documented barrier/contingency plan.
Affordability or partner pickup proposal names an eligible provider, real capacity, separate approved funding and collection workplan; no assumed free testing.
Qualified adviser selects any site-specific panel; private household data stays protected; abnormal results have a verified public-health referral.
Independent reviewer checks card against archived sources; a test, referral or normal limited panel is not credited as reduced exposure.
County water card includes a verified public-health/urgent referral and EPA-backed immediate-testing triggers and flooded-well precautions, without DIY treatment instructions.
goals.qualification: Statewide pathways researched; county service availability and outcomes not verified.

goals.title: Usable rural disposal and difficult-waste access
goals.owner: TN Waste Watch research session; local partner/reviewer unassigned
goals.next_action: Build one county card for ordinary trash, bulky waste, tires, electronics/paint and HHW; verify providers and barriers before recommending travel.
acceptance: County card verifies operator/location, hours, fees/waivers, eligibility, accepted materials and exclusions, appointment requirements, lawful destination and source dates.
Assess travel, no-vehicle, disability and work-hour barriers; printable/offline route is usable without a smartphone.
Compare at least one targeted access improvement with no-change baseline, staffing/recurring cost and burden-shift risks.
Any implemented improvement requires separately approved partner/funding and independently verified service before/after; no statewide event page treated as local availability.

Investigate the Agricultural Pesticide Waste Collection Program and the separate priced/appointment-based VSQG pathway as discovery leads; verify current provider, eligibility, material restrictions, charges and appointments before recommending either.
goals.qualification: Statewide pathways researched; county service availability and outcomes not verified.

goals.title: Community service obligations and accountable complaint routes
goals.owner: TN Waste Watch research session; local partner/reviewer unassigned
goals.next_action: Authenticate current controlling law and the pilot county service plan; prepare unsent records, complaint and county-service request templates.
acceptance: Authenticate current statute/rule, local jurisdiction and alternatives before alleging noncompliance; separate minimum duties from proposed stronger service.
Unsent records packet names verified custodian, specific existing records, dates, residency/fee rules and response tracking; no guarantee of seven-day delivery.
Complaint pathway distinguishes dumping, roadside litter, facility conditions and private-property exceptions; preserve safe lawful observation and privacy.

County commission/board proposal identifies authority, requested improvement, recurring funding, affordability, responsible owner and follow-up; local legal review precedes ordinance or citizen-suit guidance.
Permit participation uses the actual notice and its deadline/contact/accommodations; completed remedy and effectiveness checked separately from acknowledgment or vote.
goals.qualification: Statewide pathways researched; county service availability and outcomes not verified.

goals.title: Affordable community assistance and sustainable funding
goals.owner: TN Waste Watch research session; local partner/reviewer unassigned
goals.next_action: Qualify existing funding leads and recover blocked RCAP/USDA pages; verify household versus local-government eligibility and recurring costs.
acceptance: For every recommended program obtain current administering-source eligibility, geographic coverage, price/assistance terms, application window, match and operational capacity.
Testing/transport assistance and waste-service funding remain separate; a nonprofit grant is not represented as a direct household grant.
Operating costs and low-income protections accompany any mandatory-collection proposal; no burden shift or unfunded mandate advertised as a solution.
Blocked or expired programs remain explicitly unconfirmed; outreach, applications, paid services and funding commitments require separate approval.
goals.qualification: Statewide pathways researched; county service availability and outcomes not verified.

metrics.name: Publishable factual claims with source evidence
Communities lacking abundant records included in discovery
metrics.target: At least one discovery slot in pilot selection

metrics.name: Verified corrective/access/waste outcomes
metrics.target: Establish baseline, then set intervention-specific target

blocker_tasks.issue: Official current rule retrieval HTTP 403; statutory comparison TLS failure then 403. Secondary sources are not an authenticated controlling-law review.
blocker_tasks.clearing_condition: Obtain authentic current statute/rule through accessible official copy and qualified county-applicability review before legal assertions.

blocker_tasks.issue: RCAP private-well and USDA decentralized-water pages returned HTTP 403, including retries.
blocker_tasks.clearing_condition: Retrieve accessible administering source or separately approved provider confirmation of current availability/eligibility/cost.

blocker_tasks.issue: Pilot community not yet selected; no county testing or disposal card certified.
blocker_tasks.clearing_condition: G2 pilot selection followed by source-backed provider/cost/hours/material verification for G9–G11.
